{"description":"tools/check_consumer_reach.py, wired into ci.yml and the AGENTS.md gate block, with tools/test_check_consumer_reach.py as its regression net.

THE RULE: a realized Capability whose name or description claims reach beyond this repository — "any project", "a reflow2 user", "whatever project", "on your project", "every project", "a consumer" — must be REALIZED by at least one artifact a consumer actually receives: the served binary (a location under crates/) or the kit (getting-started/, plus the tools/ files release.yml copies into the kit tarball). One realized ONLY by scripts under tools/ fails the build, with the claim sentence and the realizers named, so the fix is to serve it or bound the claim — never to delete the capability to go green.

THE SHIPPED SET IS READ OFF THE DELIVERY CONTRACT, NOT A HAND LIST: the gate parses release.yml's `cp tools/<file> kit-stage/` lines. Its first run flagged the machine-wide installer (tools/reflow2_install.py) as unreachable — which release.yml DOES copy into the kit — and that false positive is what put the parse there and corrected the defect record's own sentence about the kit's contents.

OBSERVED FAILING on the unfixed export (the wall check, and only it) before the served tool was linked as a realizer; passes once crates/reflow2-mcp/src/wall_check.rs realizes the capability.

WHAT IT CANNOT SEE: a capability that claims reach in words the regex does not match, and a capability realized by nothing at all (that is `unrealized_capability`'s gap, not this one). Both are stated in the script's docstring.","name":"A capability claiming reach beyond this repo is realized by something a consumer gets — or the build fails","provenance":"authored","status":"realized"}
